purpose: A read-only live-library evaluation using the public Reading Companion production retrieval and facet-merging modules. Each fixed two-query plan tests source discovery and page identity; it does not generate or grade AI answers.

cases.question: In A Brief History of Time, how does Stephen Hawking explain black holes, and how does he distinguish observational knowledge from theoretical predictions?
